l.i: profanaret foedus Dei, si admitteret incredulos & impaeniten-
tes: faciens enim & consentiens eadem lege tenentur.
Profanare foedus dei, est venditare & agnoscere eos pro
confoederatis aut sociis Dei, qui sunt hostes Dei, ac
proinde Deum talem fingere qui obligetur hypocritis
& impiis. Dupliciter autem foedus Dei profanatur, nempe
tam communicando symbola foederis iis quibus Deus nihil pro-

main_text.l: mittit, quàm usurpando symbola sine fide & poenitentia. Si
quidem non tantum profanant qui symbola foederis
impoenitentes ad se rapiant, sed ij profanant foedus,
qui scientes & volentes symbola dant iis, quos Deus
a suo foedere exclusit. Faciunt igitur Deum socium im-
piorum, & Diaboli Filium faciunt Filium Dei, quicunque
symbola impiis dant.

impios. Inst. Si peccant qui coenam dant abutenti scientes,

page.notes: Printed page number is "6io" (old-style 1 shown as i). Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout. Small printer's marks appear in the left margin at the "Ob." line and in the right margin at several lines; they are not text and are not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "ad omnia opus" (the word "omnia" is not fully certain). "inster" (the word after "interea tamen" is unclear and may be "inster" or another form). The last word "statur" is the remainder of the hyphenated "te-statur" and is given as the catchword. Italic/roman boundaries in the Greek-free Latin are read from the scan and may be slightly off.
